shared_elements: carved stone surface in low relief
single large anthropomorphic figure filling a tall vertical field
incised linear detail (feather- or garment-like striations)
object held or hung at chest level
justification: Both are stone carvings dominated by one large frontal/near-frontal anthropomorphic figure with a tall headdress, incised linear surface detail and roundel-like discs on the body, which is the most specific correspondence. Otherwise they diverge sharply: A is a crisp, flat, pale rectangular panel with a framing inscription band and repeated floral border enclosing a profile winged figure, while B is a coarse, weathered, three-dimensional boulder-shaped monolith with no framing, no border ornament and far cruder, more eroded modelling.
